nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure returns uint c; adds two numbers and requires no overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure returns uint c; subtracts after requiring b <= a.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure returns uint c; multiplies and requires a == 0 || c / a == b.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure returns uint c; divides after requiring b > 0.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender at deployment.
Only-owner function storing _newOwner into newOwner (two-step ownership handover step 1).
Caller must equal newOwner; transfers owner role to newOwner and clears newOwner.
NEXToken constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints _totalSupply to a hardcoded address and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd on the balances mapping.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Spends allowance: decrements balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], increments balances[to], emits Transfer.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance for spender then makes an external call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, refusing ETH.
onlyOwner rescue function performing an external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
address public owner; privileged address controlling Owned functions.
address public newOwner; pending owner for the two-step ownership transfer.
string public symbol = 'NEX'.
string public name = 'NEXTAC'.
uint8 public decimals = 18.
uint public _totalSupply; total minted token supply.
mapping(address => uint) balances; token balances of every holder.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed; ERC20 allowances.
msg.sender used by Owned (constructor owner assignment, onlyOwner modifier, acceptOwnership check).
msg.sender used as the acting account in NEXToken transfer/approve/transferFrom/approveAndCall.
Arithmetic c = a + b in safeAdd guarded by require(c >= a) (arithmetic overflow class).
Arithmetic c = a - b in safeSub guarded by require(b <= a) (arithmetic underflow class).
Arithmetic c = a * b in safeMul guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b) (arithmetic overflow class).
Arithmetic c = a / b in safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0) (division-by-zero class).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) after state write in approveAndCall.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an attacker-chosen token contract.
Parameter a of safeAdd (first addend).
Parameter b of safeAdd (second addend).
Local c in safeAdd holding the addition result.
Parameter a of safeSub (minuend).
Parameter b of safeSub (subtrahend).
Local c in safeSub holding the subtraction result.
Parameter a of safeMul (first factor).
Parameter b of safeMul (second factor).
Local c in safeMul holding the product.
Parameter a of safeDiv (dividend).
Parameter b of safeDiv (divisor).
Local c in safeDiv holding the quotient.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership; candidate owner.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance.
Parameter spender of allowance.
Parameter to of transfer (recipient).
Parameter tokens of transfer (amount).
Parameter spender of approve.
Parameter tokens of approve (allowance amount).
Parameter from of transferFrom (debited account).
Parameter to of transferFrom (credited account).
Parameter tokens of transferFrom (amount).
Parameter spender of approveAndCall; also the contract called back.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall (allowance amount passed to callback).
Parameter data of approveAndCall; arbitrary bytes forwarded to the callback.
Parameter tokenAddress of transferAnyERC20Token; arbitrary external contract.
Parameter tokens of transferAnyERC20Token (amount to rescue).

edges.reason: Parameter a flows into the unchecked-style addition c = a + b in safeAdd.
Parameter b flows into the addition c = a + b in safeAdd.
Result of a + b is stored into local c in safeAdd.
Parameter a flows into c = a - b in safeSub.
Parameter b flows into c = a - b in safeSub.
Result of a - b is stored into local c in safeSub.
Parameter a flows into c = a * b in safeMul.
Parameter b flows into c = a * b in safeMul.
Result of a * b is stored into local c in safeMul.
Parameter a flows into c = a / b in safeDiv.
Parameter b flows into c = a / b in safeDiv (division-by-zero risk).
Result of a / b is stored into local c in safeDiv.
Owned constructor assigns the privileged owner from the untrusted msg.sender.
msg.sender is written into the owner state variable at deployment.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner to authorize transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, i.e. authorization derives from msg.sender.
Parameter _newOwner is stored into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership writes newOwner as the first step of the ownership handover.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to authorise the caller before clearing it.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads the current owner to emit OwnershipTransferred.
Constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets the name state variable.
Constructor sets the decimals state variable.
Constructor mints the initial _totalSupply.
Constructor credits the whole supply into balances of the hardcoded address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply (unsigned subtraction).
balanceOf uses tokenOwner as the mapping key.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the acting account comes from untrusted input.
Recipient parameter 'to' determines the credit target in transfer.
Amount parameter 'tokens' is the value moved by transfer.
transfer reads balances[msg.sender] and balances[to].
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer writes the updated balances back into the balances mapping.
approve keys the allowance on msg.sender.
Spender parameter selects the allowance entry in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value written by approve.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom consumes allowed[from][msg.sender], so msg.sender authorises the spend.
'from' parameter is the debited account and allowance owner in transferFrom.
'to' parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount moved in transferFrom.
transferFrom calls safeSub for the balance debit.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient credit.
transferFrom writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom writes the allowed mapping (allowance decrement).
allowance uses tokenOwner as the first mapping key.
allowance uses spender as the second mapping key.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall keys the allowance on msg.sender.
spender parameter is both the allowance grantee and the contract called back.
tokens parameter is the allowance and is forwarded to the callback.
data parameter is attacker-controlled bytes forwarded to the external callback.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before performing the external call.
approveAndCall invokes the external receiveApproval callback, handing control to an untrusted contract.
State (allowed) is written before the external call, so the callback executes with partially-updated state.
The callee contract can re-enter approveAndCall (or other token functions) during the receiveApproval callback.
tokenAddress parameter selects the arbitrary contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens parameter is the amount passed to the external transfer call.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender against owner to authorise transferAnyERC20Token.
transferAnyERC20Token reads owner as the external call recipient and as the authorisation source.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an attacker-supplied ERC20 contract.
Malicious tokenAddress contract can call back into the token during the external transfer call.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a is only used as an operand of the addition in safeAdd and carries no independent semantics.
Parameter b is only used as an operand of the addition in safeAdd.
Local c simply holds the result of the safeAdd addition operation.
Parameter a is only used as the minuend of the subtraction in safeSub.
Parameter b is only used as the subtrahend checked against a in safeSub.
Local c only stores the result of the safeSub subtraction.
Parameter a is only an operand of the multiplication in safeMul.
Parameter b is only an operand of the multiplication in safeMul.
Local c only stores the product computed by safeMul.
Parameter a is only the dividend of the division in safeDiv.
Parameter b is only the divisor validated by require(b > 0) in safeDiv.
Local c only stores the quotient computed by safeDiv.
_newOwner has meaning only as the input assigned to newOwner inside transferOwnership.
tokenOwner is merely the mapping key consumed by balanceOf.
tokenOwner is merely a mapping key consumed by allowance.
spender is merely the second mapping key consumed by allowance.
'to' only serves as the credit address inside transfer.
tokens only serves as the amount argument inside transfer.
spender only serves as the allowance grantee inside approve.
tokens only serves as the allowance value inside approve.
'from' only serves as the debited account/allowance owner inside transferFrom.
'to' only serves as the credited account inside transferFrom.
tokens only serves as the transferred amount inside transferFrom.
spender is the allowance grantee and the untrusted contract invoked by the external call in approveAndCall.
tokens is the allowance written and the amount forwarded to the external callback.
data is attacker-controlled bytes forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress directly controls which untrusted contract is called by the external call.
tokens is the amount argument supplied to the external ERC20 transfer call.
